integrity: The first-step identity and endpoint extremal reduction are analytic. A standard-library checker verifies the exact rational witness, the threshold polynomial reduction and isolation, and the stationary/elimination algebra. The foundational 1989 article was available only through publisher abstract and bibliographic material; the squared-polynomial identity was independently inspected in a later full-text source.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the first completed unpreconditioned CGS step in exact arithmetic for real SPD matrices with the standard shadow residual. It does not classify later iterations, preconditioned CGS, finite-precision residual gaps, or nonsymmetric/nonnormal problems.
title: Sharp condition-number threshold for a first-step CGS residual spike
